meta.title: Rentless — Rent made simple
meta.description: Rentless connects building owners with their tenants to track rent, pending dues and how long each tenant has stayed — all in one simple app that works great on a phone.

landing.badge: Built for Indian landlords and tenants
landing.title: Rent, tracked without the chasing.
landing.subtitle: Rentless keeps your buildings, tenants, rent and pending dues in one place — with automatic reminders and receipts. Works beautifully on a phone.

features.title: Everything rent, in one place
features.subtitle: From the first payment to the final receipt.

dues.title: Dues at a glance
dues.body: See who has paid, who is pending and who is overdue — colour coded so nothing slips.

auto.title: Automatic rent
auto.body: Rent charges are generated every month on the due day, so you never raise them by hand.

partial.title: Partial & advance
partial.body: Record part payments and advances; balances and history update instantly.

reminders.title: Gentle reminders
reminders.body: Email and one-tap WhatsApp reminders that keep tenants on time.

reports.title: Receipts & reports
reports.body: Download PDF receipts plus monthly or yearly collected-vs-pending reports.

tenantApp.title: Tenants stay informed
tenantApp.body: Tenants see their rent, dues, due date and full history on their own phone.

how.title: How Rentless works
how.subtitle: Set up once, then let it run.

one.title: Add buildings & flats
one.body: List your buildings and apartments with monthly rent and deposit.

two.title: Invite your tenants
two.body: Send an invite link — tenants link their account in seconds.

three.title: Track everything
three.body: Payments, dues, reminders and reports happen automatically.

roles.title: One app, two experiences
roles.subtitle: Owners manage. Tenants stay informed. Everyone sees only what they should.

points.one: A dashboard of expected, collected and pending rent
Your monthly rent and pending amount
points.two: Next due date and time lived in the flat
points.four: Raise maintenance requests in a tap

cta.title: Start managing rent today
cta.body: Free to try. No card needed. Works on any phone.

footer.madeWith: Made for landlords and tenants in India.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Rentless needs a connection for the latest numbers. Reconnect and we'll refresh your rent details.
